Chirag Mishra
Senior QA Automation Engineer | Gurgaon
chirag.mishra118@example.com | +91 9864643594 | Immediate joiner

Experienced QA Automation Engineer with a strong focus on web application testing, CI/CD integration, and building reliable automation frameworks. Proven track record of reducing regression cycle times and improving release quality through robust test suites and pipeline automation.

Experience
Finlytics — Apr 2024 - Present
Senior QA Automation Engineer (Remote)
- Developed and maintained end-to-end test suites using Cypress, increasing automated coverage for core user flows by 60% and reducing manual regression time by 45%.
- Implemented data-driven tests and reusable page objects to stabilize flaky tests, cutting test failures in CI by 70%.
- Integrated Cypress test runs into Jenkins pipelines and configured parallel execution to reduce full-suite run time from 90 minutes to 22 minutes.
- Collaborated with product and dev teams via Jira to triage and prioritize defects; improved mean time to detect critical bugs by 30%.

Medisure — May 2023 - Mar 2024
Test Engineer (Onsite)
- Built and executed TestNG-based automation for backend and frontend test scenarios, increasing test automation coverage of key patient workflows to 55%.
- Automated cross-browser UI tests with Selenium, identifying and resolving 120+ defects in pre-prod releases.
- Authored API test collections in Postman used for nightly smoke runs, catching integration regressions before deployment.
- Integrated automated tests with Jenkins for scheduled nightly builds and reported results in Jira for visibility across teams.

Razorpay — Jan 2020 - Apr 2023
Test Engineer (Hybrid)
- Created and scaled Cypress automation for payment flows, boosting automated coverage for checkout scenarios to 70% and reducing manual testing effort by 50%.
- Developed Selenium-based regression suites for legacy modules and maintained CI jobs in Jenkins to run suites on every merge.
- Leveraged Git workflows and Jira for coordinated feature testing; reduced post-release defects by 35% through early automated checks.
- Optimized test execution time by parallelizing Cypress and Selenium jobs and tuning test data management to lower flaky test rates.

Paystack India — May 2018 - Dec 2019
QA Automation Engineer (Onsite)
- Implemented Selenium automation framework and test automation best practices, delivering a repeatable regression suite for payments and onboarding flows.
- Designed automation strategies that decreased release validation time by 40% and improved bug detection in pre-prod cycles.
- Collaborated with engineers to integrate automated tests into CI pipelines and to maintain test artifacts in Git.
- Reported issues and tracked fixes via Jira to ensure timely remediation of critical production defects.

Projects
- Regression Dashboard: Built a Jenkins-driven dashboard aggregating results from Cypress and Selenium runs, displaying pass/fail trends and flakiness metrics to stakeholders.
- API Health Suite: Created Postman collections and Newman scripts scheduled in Jenkins to run nightly API health checks and notify teams on failures.

Skills
Languages: Java
Stack: Selenium, Cypress, TestNG, Automation Testing
Tools: Jenkins, Git, Postman, Jira

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
